instructions: Drain the corn really well so the salad doesn't become watery.
Finely dice the pickles, red bell pepper, and red onion.
In a small bowl, mix the mayonnaise, pickle juice, Dijon mustard, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and sugar.
Add the dressing to the corn and vegetables.
Mix everything together and fold in the parsley.
Refrigerate for at least 30–60 minutes before serving.
notes: No cooking required — just chop, mix, and chill. 3 cups of corn is about 2 cans. The submitter recommends regular full-fat Hellmann's mayo and crunchy kosher dill pickles for a deli-style result. The 30–60 minute chill is passive time, not counted in prep. The banner photo is a web photo of Israeli corn pickle salad (Debra Klein, debraklein.com).

tips.text: Chop the pickles very small so you get a little pickle in every bite.

tips.text: The pickle juice is what makes the dressing — don't skip it.

tips.text: Start with 1/4 cup mayo and add more if you want it creamier.
tips.title: Adjust the mayo
